public_primary_docs.finding: The documented REST photo-info method requires an application key even though user authentication is unnecessary. Not used in this keyless scope.
Attribution links author, work title and specific CC license; image metadata license alone does not identify the author.
A photo short link is https://flic.kr/p/{base58-photo-id}; canonical photo paths use the owner and numeric photoID.

public_primary_docs.publisher_role: Implementation note linked by official Flickr URL documentation; not blanket status for every forum post
public_primary_docs.finding: Linked base58 implementation note gives the Flickr alphabet. Pure integer conversion is used; no short-link HTTP request.

public_primary_docs.publisher_role: Flickr Staff phil dokas reply on official Help forum
public_primary_docs.finding: Staff confirms oEmbed needs no API key; API-opted-out images may yield nonphoto responses. Such slots fail; no login or key workaround.
Flickr example contains title and author fields. Those fields are optional in the protocol; license is not a guaranteed standard response field.

public_primary_docs.publisher: Primary oEmbed provider registry, distinct from Flickr own docs
public_primary_docs.finding: Flickr entry publishes HTTPS services/oembed/ and supports https flic.kr/p/* input scheme. Supports chosen endpoint/input pair; not a claim of current per-photo availability.

chosen_route: One GET at https://www.flickr.com/services/oembed/?format=json&url=<urlencoded pure-computed official short URL> per frozen photoID. No request to flic.kr, photo page, image URL, REST getInfo or any key endpoint.
framing: Single known Content-Length<=64KiB or bounded read up to64KiB of identity/chunked JSON. Unknown-length response at exact cap is rejected without extra read. Duplicate/conflicting framing rejected.
qualification: Actual photo response/author name+author URL/title and same photoID/canonical association are separate from license. Only an actual explicit CC BY2 license_url is sourceproof; absent or conflicting field stays pending. Never fills it from COCOlicense4 or numeric application fields. Additional license/rights/copyright declarations outside the same explicit accepted URL stay uninterpreted/pending; no author/title loss.
full_credits_sourceproof: Author/title/photo association plus actual explicit same CC BY2 URL; not promised in advance or inferred from standard optional fields.
RSS: Actual OS observed separately, not promised identical to commit.
